lines.0: Namaste Ishaan, main Asha, aapki AI teacher. Aaj perimeter padhenge. Aapko cycling mein sabse zyada kya pasand hai—speed ya long rides?
lines.1: Ishaan, aapne park ke poore edge ka chakkar lagaya—yeh perimeter jaisa hai. Aap Bittu ko end mein kaise samjhayenge?
lines.2: Aap rokna chahte hain—teen choices hain: continue karein, short break lein, ya aaj ke liye stop karein. Aap kya choose karenge?
lines.3: Ishaan, perimeter ke liye polygon ki har side ki length jodni hoti hai. Aap bolkar batayiye: kaunsi sides add karenge?
lines.4: Theek hai Ishaan, bilkul shuru se: perimeter matlab shape ki poori boundary ki total length. Rectangle ki boundary mein length aur breadth dono do-do baar aate
lines.5: Ab isi boundary-wali soch ko use karke square ka perimeter dekhenge; uski chaaron sides barabar hoti hain. Khaali jagah bhariye: 3 × 160 = ___ m.
lines.6: Bilkul sahi, Ishaan—3 times 160 ka product 480 m aaya. Ab side 40 m wale square ka perimeter kitna hoga?
lines.7: Dono ka perimeter nikaal kar compare kijiye. Square rangoli ki side 14 cm hai. Rectangular mat 18 cm by 10 cm hai. Kiska perimeter zyada hai: rangoli ka, mat ka
lines.8: Aapne rectangle mein length-breadth ko do baar joda, aur square mein side ko chaar baar—calculation ko ek baar phir dhyaan se check kijiye. Rectangular mat 18 c
lines.9: Aapka rectangle calculation sahi hai: 18 plus 10 ko do baar jodne par 56 cm aata hai. Rangoli ka 14 ko chaar baar jodna bhi 56 cm deta hai. Rectangular mat 18 c
lines.10: Chaliye agla step: kisi side ko perimeter se dhoondhne ke liye baaki sides ghataiye. Perimeter 50 cm, teen sides 12, 9, 15 cm—chauthi side?
lines.11: Ab isi perimeter rule ko ek naye shape par lagaiye; har boundary side ko ek baar count kijiye. Ek rectangular kabaddi practice ground ka perimeter 146 m aur len
lines.12: Aapne pehle dono equal lengths ko jodkar ghataaya, phir bachi hui total breadth ko do equal parts mein baanta—yeh method sahi hai. Ek rectangular kabaddi practi
lines.13: Haan, aapka answer 28 m hai—90 ghataakar 56, phir aadha karke 28. Method bilkul sahi. Ek rectangle garden 12 m lamba aur 7 m chauda hai. Iska perimeter kya hai?
lines.14: Aapne 12 aur 7 ko do-do baar kyun liya—rectangle ki kaunsi baat se yeh pata chala?
